subtitle: One idea per icon: few shapes, one gesture, light that carries the emotion. Ranked, strongest first. Shown under the iOS mask; the files are full-bleed 1024 squares. Dropped: C, Over the edge (at 29 px it is two dots on a line).

e-diamond-ring.title: Diamond ring
e-diamond-ring.line: An eclipse at the instant the light peeks out. The ring of light is the 0, the burst is the X. The dark moon is the bot's visor.

e-diamond-ring-face.title: Diamond ring, awake
e-diamond-ring-face.line: The same mark with the bot showing: the moon is the visor, smiling with closed eyes. Softer, more character.

a-visor.title: Visor
a-visor.line: The whole icon is the dark glass visor. One gesture: a wink, one eye closed in a smile, one wide open.

b-x0-eyes.title: X0 eyes
b-x0-eyes.line: The name is the face: a twinkle and a ring of light. Clear, but it reads a little like text.

d-players.title: Players
d-players.line: One crossing of the grid, a clay X, and a 0 that is the bot, winking. Graphic, but it says game.

c-over-the-edge.title: Over the edge
c-over-the-edge.line: Dropped: two eyes and fingertips over a horizon. Lovely large; at 29 px the fingertips vanish.
